author: Tabletop Minions
description:
People tell me they don't like indie wargames because they're hard to get into - what miniatures am I supposed to use? It's actually far easier than you think.

Miniature Agnostic t-shirts in multiple styles - http://www.tabletopminions.org and then click on MERCH in the menu

Vince Venturella and I want you to REPENT. Check out Repent! Ye Foolish Gods at http://www.snarlingbadger.com/repent

Google - https://www.google.com

I'm a member of The Army Painter Factory Team - and I'm passing the savings on to you! Use code 'FactoryUncle5' at checkout to get 5% off of your entire order at http://www.thearmypainter.com or check my favorite Army Painter products at https://thearmypainter.com/tabletop-minions

I'm now a partner on Twitch! I paint minis every Friday morning and Monday night, and sometimes take paint breaks (play video games poorly). Follow me: http://www.twitch.tv/tabletopminions

Help support the channel on Patreon, and get access to the Discord: http://www.patreon.com/tablet
title: The Hard Part About Getting Into Indie Wargames (for Some People)
